title: Walmart to finally start accepting Apple Pay and Google Pay | TechCrunch
summary: Walmart on Friday said it will finally accept payments via both Apple Pay and Google Pay at its stores, including Walmart and Sam’s Club. For Walmart, the decision reads as a defeat.
